title: The fixed ordered character-cup arrows and bar predicates
statement: For a commutative condensed ring A and topological group G, regularZero is the regular module in derived degree zero, degreeSource A q is its negative q shift, sourceTensor is the fixed right-associated tensor comparison assembled from the signed derived tensor-shift isomorphism, tensorList tensors arrows in order, and characterCup tensors the positive connecting classes and follows by the unital orderedProduct. For profinite G, a compatible bar diagram B and an equivariant injective resolution I, underived is the alternating cochain complex and resolved is the finite-diagonal total of the bar on I. augmentationArrow is the resolution-normalized actual augmentation. IsUnderivedComparison specifies a map into the row-zero summands on every component; IsCharacterCocycle specifies the product of character values on every generalized section. cocycleArrow localizes that cochain map and follows it by the actual total comparison. All fourteen definitions, including the generic unitMultiply, assembleSource and assembleShiftedSource helpers, are verbatim the fixed constructions already specified by lem-sfb-internal-bar-ordered-cup, factored into an independent definitions module.
